editor.no_impact: Clipboard validation now parses in a detached document with the same supported paste output. Main-window navigation and Android CSP hardening add no editor controls or manuscript changes.

native-packaging.breaking: none Activation writes schema 18, which apps 0.0.5 and earlier refuse; 0.0.6 reads and preserves it. Update receiving devices before transfer.
native-packaging.migration: Desktop identifier changes leave books, settings, and SQLite schema 17 unchanged. Windows retains its previous WebView2 profile; Android now requires the separate package migration below. macOS starts fresh regenerable caches and native window restore state, leaving old entries untouched. Keep the normal closed-book and profile backup before upgrade; rollback uses the previous package and preserved files. Android migration: update the previous cc.local.app to transfer-capable 0.0.3, export a complete backup copy of each book archive and separate recovery key, install com.usegarret.app alongside it, import and compare manuscripts, notes and pictures before removing the old app. Preferences need resetting; both apps stay independent. Keep exports and old books for rollback; later edits require fresh exports into a compatible build. Retain the signing key and keep increasing version codes during release preparation. none: ceiling unchanged, writes refused. Existing schema-17 books remain compatible with previous builds; no upgrade migration runs. Keep closed-book backups with adjacent originals, and restore the complete previous copy for rollback, omitting later edits. Creation and migration remain at schema 17; no upgrade runs. Schema-18 books retain their version and figure registry. Back up closed databases, originals and profiles; rollback uses a separate complete schema-17 pre-activation copy with the previous package, omitting later writing. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. Reader-only creation and migration remain at 17; fixture construction stays test-only. Upgrade preparation adds a consent boundary and retains a verified complete rollback bundle before format activation. Production remains at schema 17 with new-node authoring disabled. Activation now migrates 17 to 18 after explicit consent and a verified complete pre-upgrade copy. Read-only opens remain unchanged. Roll back by restoring the retained schema-17 copy as a separate book; later writing is absent. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
native-packaging.note: The README, release preparation notes and compatibility guide describe connection hardening, atomic records and retained-stage cleanup. Packaging and supported platforms stay unchanged.

project-format.no_impact: On Windows the import folder refuses names containing a colon, which would name another drive's folder or an alternate stream; the project format, stored books and imports on other platforms are unchanged.
